text:
isabel: Heads-up — we plan to publish the release announcement tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need final changelog + docs links from eng so we can lock copy and assets.
noah: On it, pushing the changelog PR now. aiming to merge by EOD and add canonical docs URL.
mike: Quick ask — marketing needs the exact docs path for the feature toggle (so our CTA doesn't point to a moving page).
noah: Docs path will be final: https://docs.redwood.com/release/v1.8/feature-toggle — I will add redirects.
isabel: Great. That will be the link in the blog, tweet, and release notes. Is that stable?
noah: Stable. I just opened PR: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/pull/432 — includes redirects + anchors.
jenna: Marketing note: we need the benchmark chart PNG by 18:00 so design can compose the hero image and social variants.
sam: Benchmark numbers are stable; uploaded CSV and raw charts to the PR comments. small variance against internal baseline, but the claim is fine.
isabel: Can you paste the short one-line benchmark blurb we should use in the post?
sam: "~20% unit-cost improvement vs prior baseline with parity in 95th-percentile latency" — keep it high-level, exacts in the paper.
mike: Please avoid the word 'savings' — use 'unit-cost improvement' across copy.
noah: deploy-bot: staging deploy succeeded for release/v1.8 at 2024-11-05T18:22:10Z
deploy-bot: prod deploy scheduled for 2024-11-06 08:30 PT, rolling canary: 10% -> 50% -> 100%
jenna: Webinar team wants to include the on-demand demo recording link and a CTA to sign up for a live Q&A next Wed. OK to include both?
isabel: Yes, include both. CTA should be above the fold. Link to recording is fine.
mike: Important: changelog must include migration note for KV cache config — that can affect throughput for self-hosted customers.
noah: Added migration note + example config snippet in docs (in PR):
```
redwood.runtime.kv_cache.enabled = true
redwood.batch.size = 64
```
olivia: Could eng add a short runbook link for the pre/post upgrade checklist so support and SRE can triage faster?
noah: Done — runbook anchor added on the docs page (#upgrade-checklist).
jenna: One last style request — can we freeze language: use 'unit-cost improvement' and '95th-percentile latency parity' across channels? Marketing will lock copy to those phrases.
isabel: Agreed. Locking that phrasing now.
mike: Changelog PR merged and published: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/commit/abcdef123456
isabel: Perfect. I'll schedule the publish for 09:00 PT tomorrow and ping support for inbound lead routing updates. Please flag any blockers in the next 90 minutes :hourglass_flowing_sand:
olivia: LGTM on docs and runbook.
jenna: :rocket: design will deliver hero + social assets by 18:00.
noah: :ship: prepping prod deploy hooks.
deploy-bot: prod deploy started 2024-11-06T08:30:02Z — canary 10%
support-bot: inbound routing updated — new leads tagged "v1.8_ann" and webhook to SFDC live
isabel: Thanks all — once canary clears I'll hit publish and post the announcement thread. Will follow up with the final asset bundle.
